about: Surface class of every original material of the Enhanced maps (key: the material's source name in materials.json), and the look of each class. 'materials' is written by classify_surfaces.py; correct a wrong one under 'overrides' (it wins and survives regeneration). Class fields: kind (surface, glass, water or plain = no detail layer), detail (a set of pbr_sets.json), tile_cm (overrides the set's size), rough_dark/rough_bright (roughness at the darkest/brightest green of the original texture), metallic, specular, macro_normal (strength of the normal derived from the original texture), detail_normal/detail_rough/detail_colour/detail_ao (how much of the set shows), emissive (self-lit strength for lamps and screens).
